gaps.what: Extent of the sultanate as a Dutch dependency 1828-1950 stays a confidence-1 carry-forward; the Special Region of West Kalimantan page would not load and the West Kalimantan page dates the Special Region to 12 May 1947 against 28 October 1946 on the Pontianak page

Thin items left at confidence 1: Sukadana 1834 (Tanjungpura page dates Dutch intervention to 1835), Berau 1849 (Sambaliung page failed), Sumatran cells 1856, Bone 1859, Lesser Sundas 1866, Kalimantan interior and Sumatra 1898, rest of Sulawesi 1908

Timor cessions of the Treaty of Lisbon 1859 (Maubara, Ambeno, Atauro) have no event; the Banjar contest end is 1863 here and 1860 in sultanate-of-banjar; bone's 1905 contest events have no mirror here

Padri lands: the Padri War page has Limo Puluah under Dutch rule in October 1832 and Agam conquered at the end of 1832, against padri-movement /ledger/7 (August 1837); the gain keeps the mirror date at confidence 2

Courts of Yogyakarta and Surakarta: the Dutch East Indies keeps the protectorate open 1816-1945 (infobox 1816-1942, Vorstenlanden disbanded 1945) while sultan-of-yogyakarta and surakarta-sunanate close it in 1830; se-03-a should extend those dossiers to 1945
sultanate-of-terengganu (se-03-a) lacks contest_start 1795 / contest_end 1800 naming kelantan

problems: negeri-sembilan had verdict fix and was not touched; the reviewer's two edits to it stand.
Both sides of every dependency now carry vassal events (convention stated in the notes); the research brief should say so for the other batches.
sultanate-of-terengganu (se-03-a) still lacks contest_start 1795 / contest_end 1800 naming kelantan; not edited here.

Courts: sultan-of-yogyakarta and surakarta-sunanate close their vassalage in 1830 (vassal_end, dissolve) while dutch-east-indies keeps it to 1945 on the infobox (1816-1942) and Vorstenlanden (1945); their 1830 vassal_end has no mirror here by design; se-03-a should extend them.

Siak: the review's 1858 treaty is on none of the Siak, Riau-Lingga or Deli pages; vassal_start is 21 August 1862 (Deli page: 'the State of Deli follows Siak and they together are protected by the Dutch East Indies government'), confidence 2.
padri-movement /ledger/7 dates the loss of Agam and Limapuluh Koto to August 1837 while the Padri War page has them Dutch in late 1832; check that dossier.

The 1885 loss to german-empire was dropped as a Cliopatria edge artefact (eight cells at 140.77-140.95 E, west of the 141st meridian, in no other state); the cells are restored in the keyframes from 1885, so german-empire (eu-20) needs no mirror.

Kutai: dutch-east-indies now names kutai-kingdom (which holds the Cliopatria row 'Sultanate of Kutai Kartanegara') instead of the unwritten slug sultanate-of-kutai-kartanegara; the orchestrator should keep one owner for that row.

Occupation convention: pontianak-kadriyah-sultanate names empire-of-japan (the occupier, owner-records-with-roles-reversed per the schema); empire-of-japan names dutch-east-indies for the whole Indies and has no event naming pontianak.
Mempawah (dissolve 1831) and Sambas (dissolve 1819) carry no counterpart on their own dissolve events, so the new gains have no counterpart-named mirror there even though the dates now match.
